about_the_game:
An endless labyrinth, three levels, three floors… and not a single mistake allowed.


BAD SECTOR ³ is a psychological horror game where every room looks the same, yet hides anomalies you must detect to move forward. Make three mistakes, and you’ll be thrown back to the previous floor… forced to start all over again.


Advance through an unstable structure that reshapes itself with every attempt: rooms shift, intertwine, and distort, turning the path ahead into an unpredictable maze. The iris doors open one by one, mechanical and oppressive, sealing each sector.


  • Three levels, each with multiple floors to overcome.
  • An architecture that resets after every trial, ensuring unique runs.
  • A progression–regression system that puts your nerves to the test.
  • Steam leaderboards and achievements to challenge your friends.

Fractured and corrupted, the structure cannot repair itself.


It summons you as its agent, twisting your desire to escape into a tool for its own survival.
